attackers_goals: Attackers can use the ipconfig command to discover network configuration details.
description: The 'ipconfig' command is used to display TCP/IP network configuration information and refresh the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) and Domain Name System (DNS) settings. Adversaries may use the command to discover network configuration details.
investigative_actions: Check whether the initiator process is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Check whether additional discovery commands were executed from the same process.
name: Uncommon IP Configuration Listing via ipconfig.exe
